title: Microsoft 365: Copilot Prompt Gallery - Share a prompt to a Microsoft Teams team
description: Share custom prompts with members of a Microsoft Teams team from the Copilot Prompt Gallery App, allowing team members to easily discover and utilize these prompts in Copilot Prompt Gallery App.
